messages:
Morgan: Heads-up — hit a repro during onboarding where token rotation + a short 429 burst caused duplicate generation calls from the sampleapp. Seems tied to the new 'burst_probe' path.

Anya: Can you paste the minimal repro and logs?

Morgan: Repro steps: enable feature flag 'burst_probe' in staging, run the onboarding flow, trigger rotate-token endpoint concurrently (simulates auth rotate). Log snippet: 

Morgan: ```
INFO 2026-03-20T18:01:02Z onboarding: start
WARN 2026-03-20T18:01:03Z auth: rotating token user=ui-test
ERROR 2026-03-20T18:01:04Z client: 429 Too Many Requests -> retrying
DEBUG 2026-03-20T18:01:04Z sdk: retry attempt=1 idempotency_key=NONE
DEBUG 2026-03-20T18:01:05Z sdk: request resumed after token refresh -> duplicate send
INFO 2026-03-20T18:01:05Z model: generation_start id=gc-xyz
```

Lee: Sounds like the Node SDK resumed the stream after refresh and replayed without an idempotency key. Is it Node-only or both SDKs?

Samir: Node SDK has a resume hook that attempts to resend the last chunk if it thinks the previous request failed. Python SDK currently waits and surfaces the 429 to callers. Parity mismatch.

Anya: That's risky for onboarding flows; could create duplicate side-effects in customer test data. We should prefer an explicit error over silent duplicates by default.

Jenna: infra-bot reported a short autoscaler shrink at the same time which probably contributed to the 429 spike. infra-bot: "autoscaler scaled down pool-id=dedicated-7 at 18:01:02Z"

infra-bot: "observability: 429 surge detected region=us-west-2 window=6s peak_rps=120 -> throttle triggered"

Lee: Proposed fixes: 1) disable resume-replay on token-rotate path; 2) require idempotency-key header for onboarding client flows; 3) set sampleapp default safe_replay_window_ms=0.

Samir: I'll take 1 & 2. Add guard in Node SDK so resume won't auto-send if last request had no idempotency-key or if last status==429. Config idea: 

```json
{
  "retry": { "max_retries": 3, "backoff_ms": 200, "jitter": "full" },
  "safe_replay_window_ms": 0,
  "idempotency_required_for_onboarding": true
}
```

Anya: Also emit a telemetry event when resume is suppressed so we can triage.

Samir: Will emit `sdk.resume_suppressed` with reason=missing_idempotency or reason=recent_429. Opening PR and adding unit + integration test using onboarding sampleapp. Draft PR: #4128.

devex-bot: CI queued for branch samir/resume-guard (#4128).

Morgan: After PR, flip sampleapp default to non-resumptive behavior and document in onboarding checklist.

Lee: Also add a changelog note about parity: Node changed from helpful auto-resume to conservative safe-fail.

Jenna: Ops: once PR merges, enable a canary in staging with burst_probe=true for 24h. I'll monitor autoscaler metrics. :eyes: 

Samir: Adding small stress script: `scripts/stress-onboard.sh --concurrent-rotates 5 --rps 100`. Integration test asserts no duplicate generation_start events.

Morgan: Leaving this thread as the landing place for tests/links. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

Anya: Follow-ups: Samir -> PR + tests; Lee -> changelog blurb; Jenna -> staging canary; Morgan -> doc update.

Samir: PR updated to ready-for-review, integration test reproduces refresh+429 and asserts zero duplicate generation_start events.

Morgan: Verified staging canary for 2 hours, no duplicates observed with guard in place. Closing the loop. :tada:
